Hi Samir —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and a few items to unblock procurement so we can get a pilot contract in place: 

1) Commercial path preference: do you want to proceed via PO (standard for CloudBeacon) or do you prefer corporate card / Marketplace (AWS/GCP marketplace)
2) Vendor setup packet: to register Redwood with your AP team we typically need a W-9 (or W-8 if non-US), banking details (ACH or wire), and a signed vendor onboarding form.
3) Timeline: if procurement can confirm route and provide the vendor packet by end of next week (May 16), we can aim to have terms and a paddle-ready PO within ~10 business days.

Attached is a short vendor intake checklist to speed things up. Can you confirm: preferred payment route (PO/card/marketplace), and the best procurement contact (name + email)?

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm procurement route and attach vendor packet
- If PO: we’ll send a redlined SOW + commercial summary to your procurement contact
- If Marketplace: we’ll validate SKU/pricing and send onboarding steps

Thanks — I’ll loop in Ops once you confirm so they can prepare the onboarding and tax forms.

Dylan Brooks
